name: PKU-Market-PCB: Printed Circuit Board Defect Dataset
description: Public printed circuit board defect detection and classification dataset developed by Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School (Open Lab on Human-Robot Interaction). Contains 1,386 high-resolution synthetic defect images across six defect categories (missing hole, mouse-bite, open circuit, short, spur, and spurious copper) rendered from standard PCB layout templates with bounding box annotations.
